executive_summary:
Episode 94 centers on an audio recording of Tyler Robinson's grandfather – the original owner of the rifle linked to the Charlie Kirk case – speaking with reporter Elizabeth Lane during a break at Tyler Robinson's continuance hearing. The grandfather is heard supporting his grandson and asserting that a .30-06 round would not produce the kind of damage reported. This directly contradicts the prior public framing that the Robinson family supports the prosecution.

The episode then pivots to evidentiary disputes aired at the continuance hearing. Defense attorneys Richard Novak and Kathy Nester are quoted stating that the defense has not received data files from ATF/FBI forensic testing, has not had access to Tyler Robinson's phone, and has never physically examined the firearm (reportedly held at Quantico). The host characterizes the prosecution's posture as a push for a "show trial."

In the latter half, the host turns to Laura Loomer, presenting tweets, a published Milo Yiannopoulos piece (with audio), and viral video clips as artifacts supporting allegations of psychiatric holds, weapon-prohibition status, and sexual assault against multiple men. The host also presents her own dispute with Loomer, anchored by a tweet and an insurance/court record showing a $6,987 payment to a Tracy Robinson. The episode structurally advances two threads: (1) gaps and inconsistencies in the discovery production to Tyler Robinson's defense, and (2) the host's ongoing dispute with Laura Loomer and the broader MAGA media apparatus.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson's Grandfather Publicly Supports His Grandson
claims.claim: The episode presents a recording in which Tyler Robinson's grandfather states he is at the hearing to support his grandson.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify identity of grandfather from court records and confirm whether his position is consistent with or divergent from other Robinson family members' stated positions.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson's Grandfather Cites Great-Grandfather's Law Enforcement Background
claims.claim: In a recording the host plays, the grandfather says his dad was a cop who showed him all of this; the host says this was Tyler Robinson's great-grandfather, who taught him ballistics.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify great-grandfather's law enforcement service in the relevant town and the claimed ballistics instruction.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson's Grandfather Disputes .30-06 Wound Pattern
claims.claim: The host says that, in a clip she plays, Tyler Robinson's grandfather says that is not what a .30-06 would do, and the host agrees, saying the wound did not cause any significant damage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain forensic pathology documentation regarding the actual wound and compare to documented .30-06 ballistic profile.

claims.label: Richard Novak States Defense Lacks Forensic Data Files
claims.claim: Defense attorney Richard Novak states the defense has not received the data files (electronic quantification/digitization of physical evidence) needed to analyze the forensic examiners' statistical results, saying the ATF provided material only in the last 3 weeks and the FBI still has not.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm whether data files have subsequently been produced; review any docket entries reflecting discovery status.

claims.label: DNA Reports from September 2025 Cited but Not Produced to Defense
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Novak says the evidence should have been produced up to 6 months ago because the defense has DNA reports from September 2025 that Mr. Gray relied upon.
claims.investigative_direction: Request the September 2025 DNA reports via public records or docket inspection.

claims.label: Kathy Nester States Defense Has Not Accessed Tyler Robinson's Phone
claims.claim: Defense attorney Kathy Nester states she has not been able to look at her client's phone, with the data requiring expert analysis via shipped hard drives.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify chain of custody and forensic examination status of Tyler Robinson's phone.

claims.label: Kathy Nester States Defense Has Never Seen the Gun
claims.claim: Defense attorney Kathy Nester states the defense has never physically seen the firearm.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm physical location of the firearm and whether defense examination has occurred as of case docket.

claims.label: Gun Held at Quantico in a State Case
claims.claim: Nester states the firearm is held at Quantico, Virginia.
claims.investigative_direction: Determine jurisdictional basis for federal custody of evidence in a state case; check transfer records.

claims.label: Host Says Prosecution Plans 35 Exhibits at Probable Cause Hearing
claims.claim: The host says the prosecution is planning to present 35 exhibits at the probable cause hearing.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain probable cause hearing exhibit list when filed.

claims.investigative_direction: Archive Loomer's posts with the images and run provenance and AI-detection analysis.
claims.transcript_snippet: Making up AI photos and releasing them of my husband, literal AI photos, and trying to pass them off as authentic so she can make a claim that he's gay.

claims.label: Host Says Loomer Accused the Host and Her Husband of Being Separated That Weekend
claims.claim: The host says Loomer accused the host and her husband of being separated over the past weekend.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Loomer's weekend posts making the separation claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: Accusing us of being separated, like she did this weekend.

claims.label: Loomer's Post Describes George Farmer as a Green Card Holder in Nashville
claims.claim: In the post the host reads, Loomer calls the host's husband, George Farmer, a green card holder in Nashville, Tennessee, where the host lives.
claims.investigative_direction: Immigration status is not public record; look for any statement by Farmer or his representatives.
claims.transcript_snippet: while he was allegedly driving drunk with an alleged firearm in his possession as a green card holder in Nashville, Tennessee, where you live?

claims.label: Host Says She Has Never Met Tracy Robinson and Learned His Name When Loomer Dug Up the Payment
claims.claim: The host says she has never met or known Tracy Robinson and learned the name when Loomer dug up the fact that her insurance paid a Tracy Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the court or insurance record that shows the payee and compare with the host's account.
claims.transcript_snippet: I've never met Tracy Robinson. I don't know Tracy Robinson.

claims.label: Host Says Her Insurance Did Pay Tracy Robinson $6,987
claims.claim: The host acknowledges that her insurance paid a Tracy Robinson $6,987 and that this can be found in Nashville courts.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the underlying Davidson County filing and the insurer's payment record.
claims.transcript_snippet: when Laura dug up the fact that my insurance did pay a Tracy Robinson $6,987.

claims.label: Host Says the Incident Was a Parking Lot Fender Bender on a Rainy Day Around Noon
claims.claim: The host says her husband got into a fender bender pulling out of a parking lot on a rainy day in broad daylight at about noon.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the accident report if one exists, or the court filings describing the date, location and circumstances.
claims.transcript_snippet: my husband got into a fender bender pulling out of a parking lot on a rainy day in broad daylight about noon, I think it was.

claims.label: Host Says There Was No Drinking, No DUI and No Police Called
claims.claim: The host says there was no drinking involved, no DUI involved and no police called to the fender bender.
claims.investigative_direction: Check for any police report, citation or charge in Davidson County records for the date in question.
claims.transcript_snippet: There was no drinking involved, there was no DUI involved, there were no police called.

claims.label: Host Says the Other Driver Later Claimed Whiplash and the Insurer Paid $6,987
claims.claim: The host says the other driver, Tracy, decided a couple of days later that he had post-whiplash disorder, went to the doctor, and that she and her husband had to pay a grand total of $6,987.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the claim file and any court record for the injury claim and settlement.
claims.transcript_snippet: a couple of days later Tracy decided he had post-whiplash disorder, went to the doctor, and we had to pay a grand total of $6,987.

claims.label: Host Tells Trump to Ask Roger Stone About Loomer's Suicide Attempts and the Accounts She Operates
claims.claim: The host says Trump should speak to his friend Roger Stone about Loomer's suicidal attempts, what she says and does, and the accounts she operates behind the scenes.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Stone directly; the host gives no evidence for the accounts allegedly operated behind the scenes.
claims.transcript_snippet: You should speak to your friend Roger Stone about uh, her suicidal attempts and the things that she says and the things that she does and the accounts that she operates behind the scenes.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Putting Pieces Together in His Last Week but Still Trusted People He Should Not Have
claims.claim: The host says she thinks that in the last week of his life Charlie Kirk was starting to put together a lot of pieces, but still trusted some people he obviously shouldn't have.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host which people and pieces she means and what documents or messages from that week support it.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think he uh, in the last week of his life, he was starting to put together a lot of pieces. Uh, but still some trusted some people that he obviously shouldn't have.

claims.label: Host Says the Hearings Have Not Yet Presented What Tyler Robinson Actually Did
claims.claim: The host says that what Tyler Robinson actually did has certainly not yet been presented throughout the hearings.
claims.investigative_direction: Review what was presented at each public hearing and compare it with the charging document.
claims.transcript_snippet: What did Tyler Robinson do actually? We're trying to find out and it certainly has not yet been presented throughout these hearings.

claims.label: Host Says Multiple Tyler Robinson Look-Alikes in Maroon Shirts Explain the Grainy Footage
claims.claim: The host offers as her conspiracy theory that there were multiple Tyler Robinson look-alikes wearing maroon shirts and hats that day, and that authorities will never show a clear picture of the real Robinson.
claims.investigative_direction: Request all UVU campus video and compare the maroon-shirt individuals frame by frame; the host calls this her own theory.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think there were multiple Tyler Robinson look-alikes and um, they were wearing maroon shirts and wearing hats and wearing what they were supposed to wear

claims.label: Host Says She Is Told the Footage From the Run-Up to September 10 Does Not Exist
claims.claim: The host says she heard a rumor that footage from the days and weeks leading up to September 10, which police wanted to check for reconnaissance on the roof, apparently does not exist.
claims.investigative_direction: File records requests for UVU and city camera retention policies and any investigative request for pre-September 10 footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: And that footage apparently doesn't exist either because they had speculated that someone would have had to do some recon, maybe be on this roof.

claims.label: Host Wonders Whether the Feds Took the Inside Footage of Timpanogos Hospital
claims.claim: The host says she is trying to understand whether the missing footage was taken by the feds as they took the inside of Timpanogos Hospital's footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain hospital records of any federal seizure of camera footage and a chain-of-custody log.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm trying to understand if that means that it was taken by the feds as they took the inside of Timpanogos Hospital's footage for some reason.

claims.label: Host Says There Is Evidence Charlie Went to Utah Valley Hospital First
claims.claim: The host says there is evidence that Charlie Kirk actually went to Utah Valley Hospital first, which she suggests may explain why the Timpanogos footage was taken.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare ambulance and dispatch records with hospital arrival logs for both hospitals.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe because he didn't go there first, maybe because there's evidence that Charlie actually went to Utah Valley Hospital first.

claims.label: Host Says She Believes We Are in the Truth Era and Liars Face a Collapse of Support
claims.claim: The host says she thinks we are in the truth era and that people who are lying will face a collapse of support.
claims.investigative_direction: Opinion about public sentiment rather than a checkable fact; recorded as said.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think that we are we are in the truth era and people that are lying are going to face a collapse of support.

claims.label: Host Endorses a Viewer's Claim That the First Person to Leak Kirk's Death Is a Licensed Gun Dealer With a Shady Past
claims.claim: Responding to a viewer comment, the host says she has not let up on Victor Marx and tells the commenter that it is correct that his background is shady.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the primary evidence on the timing of Marx's first announcement and his federal firearms license from ATF records.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have not let up on Victor Marx more on that. You are correct it is shady

claims.label: Host Says She Believes Robinson's Roommate Is One of the People Walking That Day and Will Appear as a Blurred Image
claims.claim: Responding to a viewer comment about Tyler Robinson's roommate, the host says she believes the roommate is one of the people walking that day, in an image that will be blurred.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the roommate's whereabouts that day against the campus video and any statements he made to investigators.
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe he's one of the people that's walking that day. That is going to be a blurred image.

claims.label: Host Says She Spoke With Lance Twiggs's Family
claims.claim: The host says she has spoken with Lance Twiggs's family.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the family members and the earlier episodes where the host described these conversations.
claims.transcript_snippet: Yep and don't forget I spoke with Lance Twiggs family.

claims.label: Host Says Lance's Family Thinks It Was Wrong That He Was Not Questioned and Was Let Go Immediately
claims.claim: The host says Lance Twiggs's family thinks there was something wrong with the fact that he was not questioned and was immediately let go.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the interview records of Lance Twiggs and the dates he was questioned, released or not detained.
claims.transcript_snippet: They think that there was something wrong with the fact that he was not questioned that he was a question of an immediate let go

claims.label: Host Asks Why They Never Send the Timestamps for the Text Messages
claims.claim: The host says it is important to get the data from the phones to make sure Lance Twiggs wasn't just texting from his phone and to see what time the messages went out, and asks why they never want to send the timestamps.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the charging documents and exhibits for message timestamps and the metadata from the phone extractions.
claims.transcript_snippet: Why do they never want to send the timestamps?

claims.label: Host Says Her Producer Discovered That the Text Messages Are Being Slightly Edited
claims.claim: The host says her producer discovered that the authorities are making slight edits to the text messages, with details promised for the next day's episode.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch the next episode for the producer's comparison of the original and the later versions, and collect each version of the messages as released.
claims.transcript_snippet: Also tomorrow we will have for you that my producer discovered that they're making slight edits to the text messages.

claims.label: Host Says the State Is Dropping New Text Messages and Making Slight Edits to Old Ones
claims.claim: The host says the authorities are dropping new text messages while making slight edits to the old ones.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect each released version of the messages and diff them, noting dates of release.
claims.transcript_snippet: they're dropping new text messages making some slight edits to the old ones.
